{
  "items": [
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0161"],
      "quote": "The Halverton Public Services Network links the Council's sites with the borough's schools, libraries and partner agencies.",
      "statement": "The Halverton Public Services Network links the Council's sites with schools, libraries, and partner agencies; this is background information.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0162"],
      "quote": "The Council's network team grants each connection after a review of the supplier's security controls.",
      "statement": "The Council's network team grants each connection after reviewing security controls; this binds the Council's team.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0163"],
      "quote": "The Council's information security policy follows ISO/IEC 27001, and its Chief Information Officer approves every new system before it goes live.",
      "statement": "The Council's information security policy follows ISO/IEC 27001 and its Chief Information Officer approves new systems; this binds the Council.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0164"],
      "quote": "The service holds personal data about residents, including health information in some environmental health and social care referrals.",
      "statement": "The service holds personal data about residents; this provides background information.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0165"],
      "quote": "The Contractor shall host the service in data centers in the United Kingdom and shall keep a disaster recovery site at least 50 kilometers from the primary site.",
      "statement": "The Contractor hosts the service in data centers in the United Kingdom and keeps a disaster recovery site at least 50 kilometers from the primary site.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0166"],
      "quote": "The Contractor shall commission an independent penetration test of the service before go-live and once a year after that.",
      "statement": "The Contractor commissions an independent penetration test of the service before go-live and once a year after that.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0167"],
      "quote": "The Contractor should publish its planned maintenance windows to the Council at least ten working days in advance.",
      "statement": "The Contractor should publish its planned maintenance windows to the Council at least ten working days in advance.",
      "modality": "should",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0168"],
      "quote": "The Council reserves the right to inspect the Contractor's hosting and support sites on ten working days' notice.",
      "statement": "The Council reserves the right to inspect hosting and support sites on ten working days' notice; this is the buyer's right.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0169"],
      "quote": "The Council's security team reviews the results of each penetration test with the Contractor.",
      "statement": "The Council's security team reviews penetration test results; this binds the Council's team.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0170"],
      "quote": "Staff sign in to Council systems through the Council's identity provider, which supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect.",
      "statement": "Staff sign in through the Council's identity provider supporting SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect; this is background.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0171"],
      "quote": "The Council's security operations are run by a shared service with two neighboring councils.",
      "statement": "Security operations are run by a shared service; this provides background information.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0172"],
      "quote": "The Contractor's service desk supports Council staff, and residents contact the Council rather than the Contractor.",
      "statement": "The Contractor's service desk supports Council staff, and residents contact the Council.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0173"],
      "quote": "Incidents are classed by priority, and the table below sets the targets for each priority, measured from the time the Council reports the incident.",
      "statement": "Incidents are classed by priority with targets set in the table; this is background narrative.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0176"],
      "quote": "Priority 1 | The service is unavailable to all users | Respond within 30 minutes and resolve within four hours.",
      "statement": "For Priority 1 incidents, the Contractor responds within 30 minutes and resolves within four hours.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0177"],
      "quote": "Priority 2 | A function is unavailable to many users | Respond within one hour and resolve within one working day.",
      "statement": "For Priority 2 incidents, the Contractor responds within one hour and resolves within one working day.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0178"],
      "quote": "Faults that affect a few users and have a workaround are handled in the normal working of the service desk.",
      "statement": "Faults affecting a few users with a workaround are handled in the normal working of the service desk.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0179"],
      "quote": "The Council's own service desk takes the first call from staff and passes incidents to the Contractor.",
      "statement": "The Council's own service desk takes the first call; this binds the Council's service desk.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0180"],
      "quote": "Where availability falls below 99.9% in a calendar month, the Contractor shall pay service credits of five percent of the monthly charge for each 0.1% below that target.",
      "statement": "Where availability falls below 99.9% in a calendar month, the Contractor pays service credits of five percent of the monthly charge for each 0.1% below that target.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0181"],
      "quote": "Availability is measured each minute from outside the Contractor's network, and planned maintenance that the Council has approved does not count against it.",
      "statement": "Availability is measured each minute from outside the Contractor's network and approved maintenance does not count against it; this provides background.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0182"],
      "quote": "The Contractor and the Council review the service levels each quarter at the service board.",
      "statement": "The Contractor and the Council review the service levels each quarter at the service board.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0183"],
      "quote": "The Council plans the implementation in three stages: design and configuration from April to June 2027, migration trials and testing from July to September 2027, and go-live on 2027-10-01.",
      "statement": "The Council plans implementation in three specified stages; this provides background information.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0184"],
      "quote": "The final migration of historic records continues after go-live, with closed cases moved last.",
      "statement": "The final migration of historic records continues after go-live; this provides background information.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0185"],
      "quote": "The service must be live for all four teams by 2027-10-01.",
      "statement": "The service must be live for all four teams by 2027-10-01.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0186"],
      "quote": "Bidders may propose a phased go-live, one team at a time, provided that every team is live by 2027-10-01.",
      "statement": "A bidder may propose a phased go-live provided every team is live by 2027-10-01.",
      "modality": "may",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0187"],
      "quote": "The Contractor shall train all users before go-live.",
      "statement": "The Contractor trains all users before go-live.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0188"],
      "quote": "The tender must name a delivery lead who stays in the role from the contract start until three months after go-live.",
      "statement": "The tender must name a delivery lead who stays in the role from contract start until three months after go-live.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0190"],
      "quote": "(a) appoint a data migration manager within ten working days of the contract start;",
      "statement": "The Contractor appoints a data migration manager within ten working days of the contract start.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0191"],
      "quote": "(b) run at least two trial migrations before the final migration.",
      "statement": "The Contractor runs at least two trial migrations before the final migration.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0192"],
      "quote": "The Council will provide two members of each team to take part in user acceptance testing.",
      "statement": "The Council provides two members of each team for testing; this binds the Council.",
      "modality": "will",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0193"],
      "quote": "User acceptance testing takes place in September 2027, after the second trial migration.",
      "statement": "User acceptance testing takes place in September 2027; this is background narrative.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0194"],
      "quote": "The Council's service board decides on go-live after it reviews the test results.",
      "statement": "The Council's service board decides on go-live; this binds the Council's board.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0195"],
      "quote": "The Council's project team has a project manager, a business analyst and a lead from each of the four teams.",
      "statement": "The Council's project team has specified roles; this provides background information.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0196"],
      "quote": "The Council has set aside space at the Civic Center for the Contractor's team during the implementation.",
      "statement": "The Council sets aside space at the Civic Center; this provides background information.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0197"],
      "quote": "The Council's project board meets every two weeks during the implementation, and the Director of Housing chairs it.",
      "statement": "The Council's project board meets every two weeks; this provides background information.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0198"],
      "quote": "The Council plans for the end of the contract from its first year, so that a later change of supplier does not interrupt the service.",
      "statement": "The Council plans for the end of the contract from its first year; this is background information.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0199"],
      "quote": "The Council's last change of supplier for a case system, in 2019, took nine months and needed a temporary extension of the old contract.",
      "statement": "The Council's previous change of supplier in 2019 took nine months; this is background narrative.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0200"],
      "quote": "On termination for convenience, the Contractor shall continue the service for up to six months at the Council's request, at the prices then in force.",
      "statement": "On termination for convenience, the Contractor continues the service for up to six months at the Council's request at prices then in force.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    }
  ],
  "no_obligation_src_ids": [
    "SRC-0174",
    "SRC-0175",
    "SRC-0189"
  ]
}
